title: 第3章 态度转变堪比川剧变脸第4章 放心现在我来了
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
先不说林朔风这个宗门大师兄是如何与一个凡人扯上关系的。
便是光看两人的年龄，这个称呼也不对吧。
哪有二十多岁的人叫十几岁的人姐的！
林朔风没有等来夏以苜的亲口回答。
等来的是陆兜兜和陆萍萍的尖叫。
他好不容易酝酿的情绪在两人的尖锐爆鸣中碎了满地。
“大师兄，你为什么要叫她姐！”
“大师兄，她刚刚动手打了你啊！你是不是被她打傻了！”
两人一左一右抓着林朔风的手臂死命摇晃。
顾不得什么规矩不规矩，此刻只想唤醒他们糊涂的大师兄。
林朔风脑浆都快被摇匀了，太阳穴突突直跳。
但也被他们提醒了一点，他和他姐的关系暂时不能公之于众。
“给我住手！”收整一番心情，林朔风才叫停了两人。
夏以苜知道林朔风已经认出她，便放松了姿态。
懒洋洋倚靠在束缚着她的灵力上。
对林朔风投去一个眼神，好整以暇地看着林朔风如何解决接下来的事情。
对上她的目光，林朔风神情逐渐从激动变成了……心虚。
到这里，林朔风心里也清楚，碧落兰的事情多半是他弄错了。
他可以不相信自己的眼睛，但他不能不相信他姐。
他姐说她是被冤枉的，那她一定是被冤枉的。

显然，他就是那个冤枉他姐，险些大义灭亲的罪魁祸首。
“林朔风，你最好给本宗主一个合理的解释，你为何要阻挡行刑！”
曹宗主的脸色差到了极点。
事情发生在孤云峰，他对林朔风本就不满，更莫说头上被剑柄砸的地方还在隐隐作痛。
弟子们窃窃私语。
“莫不是林师兄要偏袒这个手脚不干净的凡人？”
“不会吧，这件事是林师兄亲自上报给宗门的，他为什么要在这个时候偏袒？”
陆兜兜和陆萍萍极力为自家大师兄争辩。
“你们少胡说了！我们大师兄才不是这样的人！”
“紫云宗谁不知道，孤云峰林朔风最守规矩！”
便是他们这两个亲师弟师妹犯了错，林朔风都不曾为他们开脱一句。
content_en:
Let’s not talk about how Lin Shuofeng, the eldest brother of the sect, got involved with a mortal.
Just looking at the ages of the two of them, this title is not right.
How can anyone in their twenties call a teenager sister?
Lin Shuofeng did not wait for Xia Yishu's personal answer.
What awaited was the screams of Lu Doudou and Lu Pingping.
The emotions he had finally brewed were shattered all over the floor by the sharp explosions from the two of them.
"Elder brother, why did you call her sister!"
"Elder brother, she just hit you! Were you stunned by her beating?"
The two of them grabbed Lin Shuofeng's arms, one on the left and the other on the right, shaking them desperately.
They don't care about the rules and regulations, they just want to wake up their confused senior brother.
Lin Shuofeng's brain was almost shaken, and his temples were pounding.
But they were also reminded that the relationship between him and his sister cannot be made public for the time being.
"Stop!" Lin Shuofeng calmed down and stopped the two of them.
Xia Yishuo knew that Lin Shuofeng had recognized her, so she relaxed her posture.
Leaning lazily on the spiritual energy that bound her.
He cast a look at Lin Shuofeng and watched with leisurely eyes how Lin Shuofeng would solve the next problem.
Meeting her gaze, Lin Shuofeng's expression gradually changed from excited to... guilty.
At this point, Lin Shuofeng also knew in his heart that he was probably wrong about Bi Luolan.
He can not believe his own eyes, but he can't not believe his sister.
His sister said she was wronged, so she must have been wronged.
Obviously, he was the culprit who wronged his sister and almost killed her family.
"Lin Shuofeng, you'd better give me a reasonable explanation for why you blocked the execution!"
Sect Master Cao's expression turned extremely ugly.
The incident happened at Guyun Peak. He was not satisfied with Lin Shuofeng, not to mention that the place on his head where he was hit by the sword hilt was still aching.
The disciples whispered.
"Could it be that Senior Brother Lin wants to favor this mortal with dirty hands and feet?"
"No way. Senior Brother Lin reported this matter to the sect himself. Why would he be partial at this time?"
Lu Doudou and Lu Pingping tried their best to argue for their senior brother.
"Stop talking nonsense! Our senior brother is not such a person!"
"Who in the Ziyun Sect doesn't know that Lin Shuofeng of Guyun Peak is the most disciplined!"
Even if these two junior brothers and sisters made mistakes, Lin Shuofeng never said a word of excuse for them.
